changelog:
What's New in Version 1.2:

• Chest & Equipment System: Discover 5 chest tiers (Wood, Gold, Diamond, Obsidian, Blood) and earn free chests every 5 levels. Equip and reforge rare swords, helmets, and armor for powerful stat boosts.
• 10 New Risk-Reward Perks: Build unique playstyles with 10 game-changing perks including Zombie, Rage, Dodge Master, Blood Gulper, and Ignite.
• Market & Stat Upgrades: Expanded upgrade trees for Shield, Thunder, Timer, and Poison power-ups, plus permanent upgrades for Health tile healing, Critical strike chance, and Bomb damage.
• 9 New Achievements: Unlock new trophies with custom pixel art badges including Super Human, Bomberman, Corpses Talking, and Love Gambling.
• Leaderboard Chest Rewards: Weekly tournaments now award high-tier chests (Obsidian, Diamond, Gold) to top players, with reliable weekly reset cycles.
• Store Discounts: Permanent price drop on Remove Ads ($1.99) and Starter Pack ($2.99).
• Relaxed Ad Experience: Full-screen interstitial breaks are now spaced out to 8 minutes with friendly countdown warnings, plus a new 'Watch ad to claim *TAP*' bonus loot pill and a 2-stage '1-Day Ad-Free' pass.

Thank you for playing Mini Match RPG!
